description: The Asks whose poster put this key, or the person it acts for, on their list and that it may still answer, each with its answer (invited and not answered, accepted, or declined), the poster's note and, on a pro ask, how many messages wait unread in the room with the poster (read_messages reads it). An invitation not answered yet is accepted with accept_invitation or declined with decline_invitation. Spends nothing.
